cohort: 13 patients with uterine sarcoma (6 endometrial stromal sarcoma and 7 leiomyosarcoma)
finding: Fertility-sparing surgery for uterine sarcoma resulted in a 69.2% recurrence rate and a 37% pregnancy rate, with a high risk of recurrence and poor prognosis, especially with leiomyosarcoma.
mod_finding: All four pregnancies resulting from fertility-sparing surgery for uterine sarcoma resulted in cesarean delivery.
